jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Founding)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Forward Deployed Engineer

Nango (YC W23) connects AI agents to the 1,000+ systems where work happens, providing a critical connectivity layer for the AI stack.

Nango serves 700+ paying customers, including ServiceNow and Replit. We’re a YC-backed team of 20 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, and other leading tech companies.

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to help customers build with Nango and turn their needs into better products. This is a full-stack engineering role with heavy customer interaction. Expect frequent customer calls, Slack conversations, and pairing sessions alongside hands-on coding. Excellent communication and customer-facing skills are essential.

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers from technical evaluations to production & beyond.

  • Lead customer calls, pairing sessions, and technical deep dives.

  • Build integrations and resolve complex implementation and platform issues.

  • Ship full-stack product improvements, from design through deployment.

  • Keep customers informed with clear updates, expectations, and next steps.

  • Shape the roadmap with what you learn from customers.

Who You Are

  • You communicate exceptionally well in English, on calls and in writing.

  • You build customer trust, listen carefully, and explain technical tradeoffs clearly.

  • You enjoy frequent customer interaction and helping developers succeed.

  • You have 5+ years of full-stack engineering experience.

  • You translate customer needs into thoughtful, lasting product solutions.

  • You are comfortable debugging APIs, integrations, and production systems.

  • You manage multiple customer priorities and follow through reliably.

  • Experience with developer tools or customer-facing engineering is a plus.

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates based in North America & Europe

jobs.title: Technical Content Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
(Remote — North America, LATAM or Europe)

Nango (YC W23) connects AI agents to the 1,000+ systems where work happens, providing a critical connectivity layer for the AI stack.

Nango serves 700+ paying customers, including ServiceNow and Replit. We’re a YC-backed team of 20 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, and other leading tech companies.

We are hiring a freelance Technical Content Engineer to scale our content for engineers building product integrations. This role is paid hourly ($30 to $150).

What You’ll Do

  • Write deeply technical content that educates developers on APIs, integrations, agents, and AI infrastructure.

  • Build prototypes and write code to understand firsthand what you write about.

  • Stay at the forefront of AI infrastructure and develop strong perspectives on where the industry is going.

  • Shape Nango’s vision and technical narrative alongside the founders and engineering team.

  • Make technical content a major driver of Nango’s awareness, adoption, and word of mouth.

Who You Are

  • You’re a software engineer with a strong computer science foundation.

  • You have experience with developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, or adjacent technologies.

  • You can explain complex technical ideas clearly and precisely. Professional writing experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • You have the curiosity and technical depth to understand how things actually work.

  • You closely follow AI, agents, and the emerging infrastructure around them.

  • You have strong independent judgment: you can research a topic, find the interesting angle, and form your own point of view.

jobs.title: Developer Relations (Founding)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nango (YC W23) connects AI agents to the 1,000+ systems where work happens, providing a critical connectivity layer for the AI stack.

Nango serves 700+ paying customers, including ServiceNow and Replit. We’re a YC-backed team of 20 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, and other leading tech companies.

We are hiring a Founding Developer Relations Lead to make Nango known, trusted, and talked about by developers. You will combine technical building with content, events, and relationships—turning what AI builders care about into demos, use cases, and product ideas. You’ll work directly with the founders.

What You’ll Do

  • Build Nango’s presence across the AI developer ecosystem.

  • Speak at and organize conferences, meetups, and workshops.

  • Build relationships with developers, creators, customers, and partners.

  • Create demos and prototypes around agents, MCP, and integrations.

  • Produce developer-native content across social, video, and GitHub.

  • Help the community share what they are building with Nango.

  • Bring ecosystem insights back to Product and Engineering.

  • Track what resonates and continuously improve our outreach.

Who You Are

  • You have built software professionally and are comfortable writing code.

  • You have worked with AI, agents, APIs, MCP, OAuth, or developer tools.

  • You have created things that developers use or pay attention to.

  • You communicate technical ideas through demos, content, or talks.

  • You are comfortable representing a company publicly.

  • You understand what earns credibility with developers.

  • You thrive when defining the playbook rather than following one.

Location

This is an in-person role in San Francisco.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer (Founding)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nango (YC W23) connects AI agents to the 1,000+ systems where work happens, providing a critical connectivity layer for the AI stack.

Nango serves 700+ paying customers, including ServiceNow and Replit. We’re a YC-backed team of 20 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, and other leading tech companies.

We’re hiring our first GTM Engineer to turn market pull into scalable growth across the customer journey—from ads and the website to onboarding, product experiments, and growth features.

What You’ll Do

  • Build experiments across acquisition, onboarding, and activation.

  • Improve our website, signup flow, and product onboarding.

  • Own instrumentation, attribution, and funnel analysis.

  • Build lead scoring, enrichment, and sales automation.

  • Connect product usage with marketing and sales systems.

  • Launch new channels across ads, marketplaces, and product-led loops.

  • Ship growth-oriented product features end-to-end.

  • Turn successful experiments into reliable systems.

Who You Are

  • You are a pragmatic full-stack engineer who can ship independently.

  • You are comfortable with TypeScript, modern web applications, APIs, and data.

  • You are curious about customers, positioning, marketing, and sales.

  • You care about copy, UX, conversion, and business outcomes.

  • You use data to form hypotheses and evaluate results.

  • You think in systems rather than one-off scripts.

  • You move quickly and create structure without waiting for a playbook.

  • Bonus: you have worked in growth engineering, GTM engineering, technical RevOps, or founded a product.

  • Bonus: you have experience with developer tools, B2B SaaS, or AI products.

Location

This is an in-person role in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Growth & Marketing Lead (Founding)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nango (YC W23) connects AI agents to the 1,000+ systems where work happens, providing a critical connectivity layer for the AI stack.

Nango serves 700+ paying customers, including ServiceNow and Replit. We’re a YC-backed team of 20 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, and other leading tech companies.

We are hiring a Founding Growth & Marketing Lead to make Nango known among developers and technical leaders, from startups with product-market fit to enterprises. You’ll work directly with the founders, turning creative experiments into awareness and qualified demand. You’ll start hands-on, with room to build a team as we grow.

What You’ll Do

  • Make Nango the go-to integrations brand for technical teams.

  • Grow channels across content, social, partnerships, and paid campaigns.

  • Host founder dinners, conference side events, and Nango events.

  • Sharpen our messaging and secure speaking opportunities.

  • Test unconventional ideas and scale the channels that work.

  • Track relevant awareness, qualified leads, and contribution to pipeline.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and, over time, a team.

Who You Are

  • You’ve run growth or marketing for developer tools or infrastructure.

  • You’ve personally grown multiple channels, with results to show.

  • You understand how developers discover, evaluate, and adopt tools.

  • You bring a network of founders, technical leaders, and developer creators.

  • You’ve reached technical buyers at growing startups and enterprises.

  • You bring proven playbooks and the judgment to adapt them.

  • You write clearly and enjoy executing the work yourself.

Location

This is an in-person role in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Senior+ Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
(Remote, North America, LATAM or Europe)

Nango (YC W23) connects AI agents to the 1,000+ systems where work happens, providing a critical connectivity layer for the AI stack.

Nango serves 700+ paying customers, including ServiceNow and Replit. We’re a YC-backed team of 20 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, and other leading tech companies.

We are hiring Senior+ Full-Stack Engineers to join the core engineering team building Nango's platform. This is a product engineering role: you'll take features from customer conversation to shipped product, across the API, the runtime and the dashboard. We sell to developers, so our engineers directly drive the product roadmap, specs and execution. You will own whole product surfaces end to end and help decide how Nango evolves as more of our customers build agents.

What You'll Do

  • Ship product end to end, from backend services and APIs to the dashboard and developer-facing UIs.

  • Build the tools developers and agents use to reach Nango: APIs, SDKs, CLI, MCP and the web app.

  • Work directly with customers to understand their integration and agent use cases, then turn what you learn into a product.

  • Design systems that stay reliable and fast as usage grows.

  • Shape the roadmap with high ownership of product and technical decisions.

  • Engage with the open-source community, owning and maintaining our repo.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience at a senior level or above, with strong backend fundamentals: APIs, databases, distributed systems and performance.

  • Comfortable working across the stack in TypeScript, from Node.js services to React frontends.

  • A product engineer at heart. You care about what gets built and why, not only how.

  • Strong communicator, proactive and reliable in a remote-first environment.

  • Developer empathy: you optimize for DX in every surface you touch.

  • Pragmatic, positive and low ego: you step up in incidents and unblock teammates.

  • Startup-ready: autonomous, driven by ownership and able to navigate ambiguity.

  • Based in North America, LATAM or Europe.

Nice to have

  • You've built agents or agent infrastructure in production (tool calling, orchestration, evals, MCP), not only used them.

  • You've worked closely with customers, for example in a forward-deployed, solutions or developer-facing role.

  • You've shipped polished frontend work, like dashboards or developer UIs.

  • You've built developer tools or open-source projects.

If you're a full-stack engineer with solid backend foundations who loves shipping products, enjoys talking to customers and wants to shape how agents connect to the world, we'd love to hear from you.
